Cookies are secure=true. Likely only a local-development issue (plain http); not tested on https.

Re-run of the webkit-ui-login script on 3190 got 401 on POST /api/auth/login in both WebKit and Chromium: the citizenA account is not seeded on this server, so the claim could not be reproduced. Code read: session-cookies.ts:47 sets secure only when NODE_ENV=production, consistent with the claim (WebKit rejects Secure cookies on plain http; Chromium exempts localhost). Low severity is fair.
